# ADR trigger notes — R4.7e (2026-10-22)

Re-homed fired-trigger records (landed ADR bodies are frozen — BM-ADR-01;
precedent R4.7c's `2026-10-22-adr-0346-trigger.md`). Source: the R4.7e run
ledger (`docs/build/runs/R4.7e.md`) is the narrative home.

## ADR-0347 — revisit trigger on D2/D3: FIRED-ANSWERED

Trigger text: *"Reopen D2/D3 when a live judge or validator service is
admissible (the `offline-only` ceiling lifts — R2.21 or the
environment-gated critic tickets): `RecordedJudge` then composes with,
never replaces, a live `JudgePort`…"*

R4.7e lands exactly that composition:

- **A live `JudgePort` bound at link** — `hh_embed::judge_adapters` binds
  `CriticDeclaration{kind = judge}` over `GatewayModel` lanes
  (`link_judge`/`link_judged_pair`); `LiveJudge` consults through the
  model boundary with per-call usage + `hh.model_io/1` blobs drained
  durable-before-visible through the run's fenced seam.
- **`RecordedJudge` composes, never replaces** — it stays the replay
  binding as D3 predicted: `assess`/`take_records`/`take_model_io` default
  to abstentions (`recorded_judge_replay_abstains_and_drains_nothing`),
  and `judge()` answers the recorded panel verdict byte-identically —
  `has_recording`-gated so a 0-answer is replay, not abstention
  (`r4_7e_live` judge-run; `hh-live-evidence/1`
  `2026-10-22-judge-run.json`).
- The `handle:` subject-spelling half of the trigger stays as written —
  no live `EvidenceRef` handle spelling was needed.

D2/D3 stand — the live binding takes the shape the ADR predicted rather
than revising it.

## ADR-0348 — revisit trigger on D3: FIRED-ANSWERED

Trigger text: *"Reopen D3 when a live judge binding is admissible (the
`offline-only` ceiling lifts — R2.21): `judge_context_for` then composes
with a live `JudgePort`, never replaces it."*

The live binding is admissible and landed (`judge-calibrate`/`judge-run`
legs, `hh-live-evidence/1` records). `judge_context_for`'s eval-side
`IndependenceVector`/`CalibrationStatus` consumption is unchanged — the
live port's link-time `declare_critic` consumption is the complementary
surface the trigger anticipated; nothing replaces. D3 stands.

## ADR-0300 — revisit trigger (critic tickets bind `Validator{kind:
judge}` to `JudgePort`): FIRED-ANSWERED

Trigger text: *"Reopen when … the critic tickets bind real
`Validator{kind: judge}` implementations to `JudgePort`/`MergeValidator`…"*

`LiveJudge` + `PanelJudge` are real `JudgePort` implementations bound at
link (`crates/hh-embed/src/judge_adapters.rs`); the driver's judged
loop-detector arm + completion-gate `assess` arm consult them on a real
run. No change to the ADR's coordination rulings — the port's contract
(`assess`/`take_records`/`take_model_io`) widened additively with
defaulted abstentions, preserving the recorded-binding byte-identity.

## ADR-0311 — revisit trigger (b): FIRED-ANSWERED

Trigger text: *"Reopen when … (b) the critic-variant tickets bind
`CriticDeclaration{kind = judge}` at `link` on live runs and the
calibration/independence members need to ride the binding surface rather
than the verdict."*

The binding landed at `link`. The calibration/independence members ride
**both** surfaces as the check requires: the declared `calibration_ref` +
snapshot axis are consumed at bind time inside `declare_critic`
(overclaim refused + re-based to the derived axis), and the folded facts
restate durably on each verdict row (`calibration_ref`,
`independence_summary`) + each per-critic `claim.reconciled{detector =
judged}` record — the verdict-carried form remains the durable evidence,
the binding-surface consumption is the gate. (a) — a kernel-reachable
judge gateway — stays as written: `LiveJudge` rides the existing
`GatewayModel`/`ModelLane` boundary, no new gateway needed.
